newsitem.title: USA: Old America Stores Q4 same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Old America Stores Q4 same-store sales up.

text.p: Old America Stores Inc Thursday announced that total sales for the fourth quarter ended Feb 1, 1997 increased 10.3 percent to $45.8 million from $41.5 million for the fourth quarter of the prior fiscal year.
Same store sales for stores open more than one year rose 0.4 percent compared with the same period a year ago.
Sales for the 12 months ended February 1, 1997 rose 0.8 percent to $135.7 million from $134.6 million last year.
Same store sales decreased three percent from the prior fiscal year.
